summary.scope: Twenty-four logical cases are covered by nine genuinely passing boundary cases, three repaired memory/boundary cases and twelve journey cases on the same 75 runtime files. The sole final input difference is the exact reconstructed test-only direct-download correction. This is not a single all-green twenty-four-case batch: the original three memory test failures remain diagnostic. Older release/repair/pilot batches retain their own input/runtime hashes and red/green history, contribute zero final coverage, and may use another runtime. Restored memory endings, visual fixtures, memory openings and early failures are not additional full twelve-day UI runs. All recorded run objects replay through the current SDK; collection envelopes are validated, while preserved-storage observations are separate records.
